tools.name: binary_cube_list_acceptance_families
tools.description: List the representative payload families used by the default Binary Cube strengthening acceptance campaign.

tools.name: binary_cube_run_acceptance_campaign
tools.description: Run every required strengthening acceptance gate across representative low-entropy, patterned, boundary, mixed, and multi-block payload families. Promotion requires every configured family to pass in one runtime.

families.description: Optional custom campaign cases. Omit to use the canonical representative family set.
